3. Limbs/Anatomy: The Router correctly observed the single dorsal fin set far back, whereas barracouta have two separated dorsal fins. 

The Router was not too lenient; in fact, it was appropriately strict given the clear taxonomic mismatch. All checkpoints marked 'false' are genuinely absent or incorrect for the target class.
